## SMS Import

Single Responsibility: webhook entrypoint for any SMS-forwarding tool (e.g. MacroDroid, Tasker, a Twilio inbound webhook) that posts a raw SMS into this n8n instance. Normalizes the payload, then hands off to 02 - Processing / Parse Transaction. The whole pipeline result is returned in the HTTP response.

This is a parallel, n8n-native path — independent of the app's own /api/imports/sms endpoint (which uses a different, already-battle-tested pipeline). Built at explicit request even though it duplicates that logic; the two will not stay in sync automatically.

Expected POST body: { from?: string, body: string, receivedAt?: ISOString }. Adjust 'Normalize Payload' if your SMS forwarder uses different field names (e.g. Twilio sends { From, Body }).

Webhook URL (after import, self-hosted): <your-n8n-instance>/webhook/budgetflow/sms-import

nodes.name: Parse Transaction
nodes.notes: After importing, point this at the "02 - Processing / Parse Transaction" workflow (n8n assigns IDs on import). This one call cascades through the whole pipeline (Validate → Duplicate Check → Categorize → Create Transaction → BudgetFlow handles all downstream business logic).
